body: ## **Description** The Perps order-entry "Size" section previously showed two always-visible, side-by-side input fields (USD on the left, the asset/token on the right). This replaces them with a single size input that toggles its denomination between USD (default) and the asset (e.g. BTC) via a swap icon, matching the reference design (`Size | 0.00 USD ⇄`). What changed and why: - A single `TextField` now renders the size, with a `Size` label on the left and the active unit (`USD` or the asset symbol) plus a swap toggle on the right. - Tapping the swap icon switches the input denomination; the value is converted at the current price so the position size stays equivalent. - USD remains the internal source of truth (`formState.amount`), so `usePerpsOrderForm`, margin/fee/liquidation calculations, the slider, the percentage input, and order submission are all unchanged regardless of the active denomination. - The selected denomination is persisted per market for the current session via a lightweight in-memory store, so navigating away and back to the same market keeps the last-used denomination. Scope: - In: new order entry size input (`AmountInput`) and a small session store. - Out: close-position flow (`CloseAmountSection`), modify flow, and mobile (unchanged). ## **Changelog** CHANGELOG entry: Changed the Perps order entry size field to a single input with a swap toggle between USD and asset denominations. ## **Related issues** Fixes: https://consensyssoftware.atlassian.net/browse/TAT-3473 ## **Manual testing steps** ```gherkin Feature: Perps order entry single size input with denomination toggle Scenario: Size input defaults to USD Given I open a new Perps order for a market (e.g. BTC) When the order form renders Then the Size field shows a single input with the "USD" unit and a swap icon Scenario: Toggle to the asset denomination Given I have entered a USD size (e.g. 9000) for BTC at the current price When I tap the swap icon Then the input switches to the asset unit (e.g. "BTC") And the displayed value is the equivalent asset amount at the current price Scenario: Toggle back to USD Given the input is in the asset denomination When I tap the swap icon again Then the input switches back to "USD" showing the equivalent USD value Scenario: Typing in asset denomination keeps the order equivalent Given the input is in the asset denomination When I type an asset amount Then the internal USD size used for margin/fees updates to amount x price Scenario: Slider and percentage still work Given the order form is open in either denomination When I move the size slider or edit the percentage field Then the size and balance percentage update correctly Scenario: Denomination persists within the session Given I toggled the BTC size input to the asset denomination When I navigate away and return to the BTC market in the same session Then the size input is still in the asset denomination ``` ## **Screenshots/Recordings** ### **Before** ### **After** ## **Pre-merge author checklist** -
